fails.text: Stronger, faster, better looking. Obviously.
fails.reason: 'Stronger, faster, better' paraphrases the well-known Six Million Dollar Man catchphrase 'better, stronger, faster'.
fails.suggestion: Fresh torque, same genius. You're welcome.

fails.text: Ow. Okay, that one was personal.
fails.reason: 'That one was personal' leans on the well-known tagline 'This time it's personal', and the line has no Rigs flavour.
fails.suggestion: Ow. Hull patch needed. Several, actually.

fails.text: Come get some, tin cans!
fails.reason: 'Come get some' is a well-known catchphrase (Army of Darkness / Duke Nukem).
fails.suggestion: More tin cans, more scrap. Love it.

fails.text: Yippee-ki-yay, Kessler-Voss. Thanks for the ore.
fails.reason: 'Yippee-ki-yay' is the Die Hard catchphrase.
fails.suggestion: Full payload, full cut. Bye, Kessler-Voss.

fails.text: Jackpot! Mama needs a new gun.
fails.reason: 'Mama needs a new gun' paraphrases the well-known catchphrase 'Mama needs a new pair of shoes'.
fails.suggestion: Jackpot! Somebody's cut just got bigger.

fails.text: Pick one. Try not to overthink.
fails.reason: 'Try not to overthink' is aimed at the player's choice rather than at Rook's plans or bravado.
fails.suggestion: Pick one. Think first. Unlike Ceres.

fails.text: Well. That was a very expensive nap.
fails.reason: Mocking the failed run ('expensive nap') targets the player's performance, not Rook's plans.
fails.suggestion: Well. Still not as bad as Ceres.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
fails.reason: Propaganda aimed at an intruder event, and it sells the Rigs' own console as a Kessler-Voss product; label propaganda and text both must change to bureaucratic.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered device detected on claim network. Access logged.

fails.text: Unauthorized console retrieval will be logged under Form 27-B.
fails.reason: 'Form 27-B' echoes the famous 'Form 27B/6' of the film Brazil, and 'retrieval' misdescribes a console being dropped.
fails.suggestion: Unauthorized device on claim network. Access attempt recorded.

fails.text: Surprise! A Kessler-Voss Rewards Crate has arrived for valued guests!
fails.reason: Playful propaganda ('Surprise!', 'valued guests') aimed at intruders instead of cold bureaucracy; change label and text to bureaucratic.
fails.suggestion: Supply crate flagged. Contents reserved for asset recovery.

fails.text: Security response dispatched. Compliance is mandatory and appreciated.
fails.reason: 'Compliance is mandatory' indirectly orders the player to stop instead of stating what the company does.
fails.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Extraction irregularity flagged for removal.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Safety Team is coming to meet you!
fails.reason: Jokey propaganda ('coming to meet you!') aimed at intruders; change label and text to bureaucratic.
fails.suggestion: Security units deployed. Unauthorized personnel scheduled for removal.

fails.text: Your premium departure experience awaits. Thank you for visiting!
fails.reason: Propaganda thanking intruders for visiting, and the company speaks as if it hosts the Rigs' shuttle; change label and text to bureaucratic.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered craft detected on claim. Asset recovery en route.

fails.text: Departure window closing. Late exits will be processed as trespass.
fails.reason: Threatens the player's exit instead of stating what the company does (reinforcements arriving).
fails.suggestion: Extraction crews inbound. Remaining trespassers will be processed.

fails.text: Say hello to my little friend, but louder.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Scarface line 'Say hello to my little friend'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Lethal Weaponize: bigger bang, smaller robot.

fails.text: Go ahead, make my day. Repeatedly.
fails.reason: Quotes the Dirty Harry line 'Go ahead, make my day'.
fails.suggestion: Trigger finger on redline. Tin cans hate that.

fails.text: Hasta la vista, empty magazine.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator 2 catchphrase 'Hasta la vista, baby'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Speedbump: fresh mag before the doubt.

fails.text: Feeling lucky, punk? Because I do.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Dirty Harry line 'Do you feel lucky, punk?'.
fails.suggestion: Every bolt finds the soft spot now.

fails.text: That one is gonna leave a mark, buddy.
fails.reason: 'That's gonna leave a mark' is a well-known catchphrase, and 'buddy' is generic rather than Rook.
fails.suggestion: Weak spot found. Scrap goes airborne.

fails.text: I'll be back. Eventually. Sturdier, too.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator catchphrase 'I'll be back'.
fails.suggestion: Extra hull patch. Rook stays in one piece.

fails.text: Get to the choppa, but I'm already there.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Predator line 'Get to the choppa'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Running Late Man: never late twice.
